TOYOSU MARKET · KAI-SEN-DON

Nakaya

Fresh seafood and hearty market meals in Toyosu.
Fresh seafood bowls and authentic Toyosu Market cuisine.

Seafood Bowlから刺身、フライ、定食まで。市場ならではの魚介を、朝からしっかり楽しめる店。人気のSeafood Bowlはもちろん、まぐろの中落ちや大きなアジフライもNakayaの名物です。

AT A GLANCE

Start your market morning at Nakaya.

Nakaya serves fresh seafood bowls, fried dishes and set meals. A hearty choice for a market breakfast or a meal after exploring Toyosu.
